pages.text: [#](53341a)A rite is the intentional manipulation of the world through circle, ingredient, and power. The circle gives structure; the ingredient names the working; the altar provides fuel.[#]()
pages.title: Rites of Power

pages.text: [#](53341a)Some rites also need creatures present — part of the mechanism, not ceremony.[#]() [#](53341a)The complete compendium follows. Search it by a rite, result, condition, or offering; every working is recorded with its exact circles and costs.[#]()

[#](53341a)Each family groups workings that share a purpose. Every variant still has its own card: circle layers show chalk and size, witch faces show the minimum coven, and live items show the offerings. A **gold frame** marks an optional focus.[#]()
pages.title: Reading the Cards
